summary: Alaska State Troopers charged a Fairbanks man with drink-driving and driving on a revoked license after a Nov. 20 traffic stop, and the Fairbanks court opened a Class C felony weapons case against a Fairbanks woman that no police agency has publicly described. Troopers also reported a second drink-driving arrest near Peger and Davis roads, a warrant arrest at Mile 269 of the Parks Highway, and the arrest of a juvenile for drink-driving near North Pole. Seven charges, one of assault in the fourth degree and six of assault when a child is present, were filed against a Fairbanks woman over a Nov. 19 domestic disturbance. The court filing counts below are the weekly charges report's own counts for the week ending Nov. 20; the Fairbanks court has since opened four further files, numbered 4FA-26-02320CR to 4FA-26-02323CR, which that report does not cover.

entries.title: Felony weapons charge: Angela Lynn Kavirran Petrick
body: Angela Lynn Kavirran Petrick is charged with misconduct involving weapons in the third degree - possessing a concealable firearm in the home of a known felon - a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years.
The offense is recorded as having happened at Fairbanks on Nov. 20. No police or trooper account of the arrest has been published.
Case 4FA-26-02322CR, filed Nov. 21. Next court date Dec. 1.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Jordon Kokrine
body: Jordon Joseph Kokrine is charged with driving under the influence with a breath or blood alcohol level of .08 or more, and with driving after a previous conviction for driving on a revoked license. The court records both as Class A misdemeanors.

Troopers say they stopped his vehicle in Fairbanks on Nov. 20 for an inoperable taillight, that he showed signs of alcohol impairment and said he had been drinking before driving, that open alcohol containers were found in the vehicle, and that a breath test at the Fairbanks trooper post returned 0.122.
Case 4FA-26-02323CR, filed Nov. 21. Next court date Jan. 14, 2027.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Felipe Gomez
body: Felipe Soto Gomez was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence. The court file carries no charge yet, so no charge class is stated.

Troopers say they stopped him near Peger Road and Davis Road in Fairbanks at about 5:54 p.m. on Nov. 20 after he nearly struck a trooper vehicle and hit a street sign, that he showed several indicators of alcohol impairment, and that he gave a breath sample of 0.247 at the trooper post.
Case 4FA-26-02320CR, filed Nov. 21. Next court date Nov. 27.

entries.title: Trespass arrest: Florence Delores Folger
body: Florence Delores Folger, 69, was arrested on a charge of criminal trespass in the second degree - entering or remaining unlawfully on another person's premises - a Class B misdemeanor.
1600 block of East Cowles Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 20 at 11:19 p.m.; Fairbanks Police. Police case 26003530.
Case 4FA-26-02321CR, filed Nov. 21. Next court date Nov. 27.

entries.title: Warrant arrest on the Parks Highway: Roman Pugach
body: Roman Pugach, 39, of Wasilla, was arrested on an outstanding $250 misdemeanor warrant for theft in the third degree.

Troopers say they were conducting a traffic stop at Mile 269 of the Parks Highway at about 7:30 p.m. on Nov. 20 when a second vehicle stopped at the same place because its driver knew the driver of the first, and that the second driver was found to have the warrant.
He was remanded to Fairbanks Correctional Center. Mile 269 lies between Healy and Nenana.

entries.title: DUI arrest of a juvenile near North Pole
body: A juvenile was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence. Juveniles are not named in this report.

Troopers say they responded to the North Pole area on Nov. 21 on a report of a driver suspected of being impaired, that the driver was a juvenile found to be under the influence of alcohol, and that the juvenile was released to a guardian after the arrest.

entries.title: Reckless driving and school bus charges: Dylan Batten
body: Dylan Batten, 18, of Fairbanks is charged with reckless driving, which the court records without a classification, and with failing to stop for a school bus, a Class B misdemeanor.

Troopers say they took multiple calls in Fairbanks at 8:32 a.m. on Nov. 18 about a vehicle driving into oncoming traffic and passing several school buses whose stop signs were out, and that they located the vehicle and arrested the driver.
Case 4FA-26-02306CR, filed Nov. 18. Next court date Nov. 24.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault charges: Emeline Janice Gallahorn
body: Emeline Janice Gallahorn is charged with assault in the fourth degree - recklessly causing physical injury to another person - and with six counts of assault when a child is present. The court records all seven counts as Class A misdemeanors and flags all seven as domestic violence related.

Troopers say they responded to a report of a domestic disturbance at a residence in the Fairbanks area on Nov. 19, that she assaulted an adult family member in the presence of several children, and that she was detained nearby.
Case 4FA-26-02319CR, filed Nov. 20. Next court date Jan. 14, 2027.

entries.title: Assault arrest: Victor William Kunayak
body: Victor William Kunayak, 18, was arrested on two counts of assault in the fourth degree - one of recklessly causing physical injury, one of placing another person in fear of imminent injury - both recorded by police as misdemeanors.
100 block of Lacey Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 19 at noon; Fairbanks Police. Police case 26003190.
No court file has been opened under this name at Fairbanks.

entries.title: Disorderly conduct charge: Ellis Mathew Akpik
body: Ellis Mathew Akpik, 37, is charged with disorderly conduct - creating a hazardous condition for others - a Class B misdemeanor.
100 block of College Road, Fairbanks, Nov. 19 at 6:31 p.m.; Fairbanks Police. Police case 26003514.
Case 4FA-26-02314CR, filed Nov. 20.

entries.title: Bail violation charges: Justice Elijah Nukapigak
body: Justice Elijah Nukapigak is charged with three counts of violating conditions of release - breaking a condition of release set in a misdemeanor case - all Class B misdemeanors.
The offenses are recorded as having happened at Fairbanks on Nov. 19.
Case 4FA-26-02318CR, filed Nov. 20. Next court date Jan. 7, 2027.
